WITH RECURSIVE date_range AS (
    SELECT DATE '2020-01-01' as dt
    UNION ALL
    SELECT dt + INTERVAL '1' DAY
    FROM date_range
    WHERE dt < DATE '2020-04-28'
),
customer_running_balances AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        txn_date::DATE as txn_date,
        SUM(CASE 
            WHEN txn_type = 'deposit' THEN txn_amount 
            WHEN txn_type = 'purchase' THEN txn_amount 
            WHEN txn_type = 'withdrawal' THEN -txn_amount 
            ELSE 0 
        END) OVER (
            PARTITION BY customer_id 
            ORDER BY txn_date
            ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
        ) AS balance_after_txn
    FROM customer_transactions
),
customer_min_max_dates AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        MIN(txn_date) as min_date,
        MAX(txn_date) as max_date
    FROM customer_running_balances
    GROUP BY customer_id
),
customer_daily_balances AS (
    SELECT 
        cust.customer_id,
        cust.min_date,
        cust.max_date,
        dr.dt as daily_date,
        crb.balance_after_txn as txn_balance
    FROM customer_min_max_dates cust
    CROSS JOIN date_range dr
    LEFT JOIN customer_running_balances crb
        ON crb.customer_id = cust.customer_id 
        AND crb.txn_date = dr.dt
    WHERE dr.dt >= cust.min_date AND dr.dt <= cust.max_date
),
daily_balances_with_prev AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        daily_date,
        txn_balance,
        LAG(txn_balance) OVER (
            PARTITION BY customer_id 
            ORDER BY daily_date
        ) as prev_balance
    FROM customer_daily_balances
),
final_daily_balances AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        daily_date,
        txn_balance,
        LAG(txn_balance) OVER (
            PARTITION BY customer_id 
            ORDER BY daily_date
        ) as prev_balance,
        FIRST_VALUE(COALESCE(txn_balance, prev_balance, 0)) OVER (
            PARTITION BY customer_id 
            ORDER BY daily_date
            ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
        ) as daily_balance
    FROM daily_balances_with_prev
),
monthly_max_balances AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        EXTRACT(MONTH FROM daily_date) as month,
        MAX(daily_balance) as max_daily_balance
    FROM final_daily_balances
    GROUP BY customer_id, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM daily_date)
),
monthly_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        month,
        SUM(max_daily_balance) as total_max_balance
    FROM monthly_max_balances
    GROUP BY month
)
SELECT 
    CASE m.month WHEN 1 THEN '2020-01' WHEN 2 THEN '2020-02' WHEN 3 THEN '2020-03' WHEN 4 THEN '2020-04' END as month,
    total_max_balance
FROM monthly_totals m
ORDER BY m.month
